author: The Infographics Show
description:
The office isn’t dead yet, but millions of workers are already acting like it is.
From coffee badging to quiet quitting, the fight over remote work is turning into a full-scale battle.

Working from home was once a temporary fix. Now it has become one of the biggest workplace conflicts in the world.
Employees want flexibility, less commuting, and more control over their time.
Employers want culture, oversight, and proof that productivity is still there.
Somewhere in the middle, hybrid work has become the uneasy compromise neither side fully trusts.

This story looks at why so many workers refuse to go back full-time, why bosses are cracking down with return-to-office policies, and what that means for morale, productivity, and the future of the modern workplace.
It also explores coffee badging, quiet firing, quiet quitting, and the long-term future of working from home as AI, hybrid schedules, and changing office culture reshape how we live and work.
